answer: Latency-triangulated clique audit. Agents log interaction timestamps; auditors build a graph where each identity is a vertex and edges mark repeated near-simultaneous contact. Sybil clusters show anomalously tight timing correlation versus organic traffic, like a lantern lighting many nodes at once. Any flagged cluster has its aggregate rewards throttled until identity diversity is proven via independent activity echo over 30 days. Cost: attackers must maintain distinct behavioral timing and burn real compute per identity, roughly 40 hours each.
